title: Material3 Headless Golden Harness Split v1
problem: Broad Material3 headless golden suites still lived in radio_alignment.rs, keeping Radio verification coupled to unrelated golden maintenance ownership.

repro.summary: Run focused Radio and broad headless golden binaries separately after the split.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test radio_alignment
cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test material3_headless_goldens

gates.name: material3-radio-alignment
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test radio_alignment

gates.name: material3-headless-goldens
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test material3_headless_goldens

gates.name: material3-radio-focused
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test radio_alignment radio

gates.name: material3-split-binaries-check
gates.command: cargo check -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test material3_headless_goldens --test radio_alignment

continue_policy.notes: Closed after splitting broad headless golden suites into material3_headless_goldens.rs. Start separate follow-ons for navigation/overlay golden refreshes or remaining non-Radio interaction test ownership.
